title: The Book of Zephaniah
lead: Zephaniah son of Cushi prophesied in Judah in the reign of Josiah (640 to 609 BC). The three chapters of his book announce the day of the LORD against Judah and the whole earth, call the humble to seek the LORD, judge Philistia, Moab, Ammon, Cush and Assyria, accuse Jerusalem, promise the nations pure lips and end with the LORD singing over a rescued Daughter Zion.
